criteria.why: Three-peg legal-move story motivates reusing a smaller tower job rather than guessing arbitrary moves.
criteria.naive: Hand-written movements repeat smaller tower work with changed peg roles; full graph search is distinguished from this constructive method.
criteria.observation: Clear largest disk, move it, restore smaller tower gives three ordered subjobs.
criteria.intuition: One call promises a legal transfer of n top disks, defines all four arguments, base zero and decreasing measure.
criteria.worked_example: All seven legal moves for three disks show complete physical states bottom-to-top; count returns 0,1,3,7 separately.
criteria.correctness: Induction proves legality; disjoint transfers before the first and after the last largest-disk movement give a lower bound even for solutions moving it repeatedly.
criteria.time_reasoning: 2^(n+1)-1 output-function calls and 2^n-1 printed moves; count function makes only one child call, O(n).
criteria.space: Maximum active depth n+1 and O(n) auxiliary storage, distinct from exponential total calls.
criteria.cpp_implementation: Four meaningful count/first-transfer/middle-plus-second/main fragments are explained and concatenate exactly to complete C++17.
criteria.walkthrough: Two-disk return ordering and three-disk states match the compiled output and sample.
criteria.edge_cases: Zero through sixteen disks, distinct pegs, no negative disk counts, output-size bounds.
criteria.mistakes: Incorrect role permutation, early move, missing progress, mutating --disks twice, return scope and shared-state restoration are explained.
criteria.related: Complexity and stack/queue references retained; repeated rectangles motivate memoization without claiming it solves Hanoi output faster.
criteria.prerequisites: Function arguments/returns and conditionals explicitly required; advanced search/DP practice remains optional.
criteria.practice: All five prior tasks retained; Raisins extension added, every stage explains a distinct transfer of knowledge.
criteria.priority: High tutorial rationale; only Tower of Hanoi is core, Creating Strings becomes locally optional without global demotion.
criteria.checklist: Calls, return flow, two proof obligations, resources and independent implementation separately assess mastery.

criteria.working_links: Official CSES Hanoi positive n<=16 contract checked; teaching extension explicitly allows zero. Native six practice links resolve.
